title: Paginate the todo list
user_story: As a user with a long list, I want `GET /todos` to be paginated so that the app stays fast.

results.reasoning: The code slices the todo list using the limit and offset parameters, and the test verifies that requesting limit=2 on 3 items returns at most 2 items.
The implementation correctly applies the offset parameter to slice the items list, but there is no test in the diff verifying offset behavior.

results.text: A `limit` greater than 100 is rejected with 422.
results.reasoning: There is no validation logic to reject limits greater than 100 with a 422 status code, and no test for this requirement.
